name: direct-unknown-startup
description: Guard against punishing small/unknown employers: a no-name startup hiring for itself — channel direct (or unknown at worst), trust may be unknown but never suspicious.

posting.title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
posting.description: Quietloop Labs is a seed-stage startup building developer tooling for observability pipelines. As our founding full-stack engineer you will own the product end to end: React/TypeScript frontend, Node backend, Postgres, deployed on AWS. You'll work directly with the two founders. Competitive salary plus meaningful equity. Apply with your resume and a note about something you've built.
